title: Little Stewarts Old World — Map & Encounters
summary: DM map tracker and twelve prepared encounters for Old World travel.

map.alt: Stylized Old World map showing regions, settlements, travel routes, and twelve encounter markers.

instructions: Let the party choose a direction or landmark from the map.
Use the matching number if they travel into that region.
Check Discovered when they learn about it or pass nearby.
Check Completed when they resolve it by combat, parley, escape, or clever nonsense.

encounters.name: Thorn Court Hunt
encounters.location: Path to the Convergence • Ancient forest / fey road
encounters.hook: Masked fey hunters mistake Coleman’s giant spirit-bulldog form for sacred quarry.
encounters.roster: 1 Thorn Captain: AC16 HP70 +6, 2d8+4; 2 Briar Knights: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3; 3 Needle Sprites: AC13 HP12 +4, 1d6+2
encounters.battlefield: Moving hedges, mushroom rings, low branches. At the top of each round, one path closes and another opens.
encounters.motivation: The fey want proof the party is not poaching a sacred white stag.
encounters.alternateEndings: Single combat, apology, fey token, or showing Coleman is a person.
encounters.reward: Moonleaf clasp: ignore plant-based difficult terrain once.

encounters.name: Moss Titan Boundary
encounters.location: Petaltown wildwood edge • Old forest ruin
encounters.hook: The party crosses an invisible border and awakens a guardian older than the current kingdoms.
encounters.roster: 1 Moss Titan: AC17 HP110 +6, 2d10+4; 2 Stone Wardens: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3
encounters.battlefield: Broken columns, buried arch, standing stones. Titan can move one terrain piece each round.
encounters.motivation: Ancient command: “No crown-bearer may pass the Seventh Gate.”
encounters.alternateEndings: Leave the boundary, hide royal symbols, place weapons down, or find the carved password.
encounters.reward: Guardian stone: grows warm near ancient imperial ruins.

encounters.name: Clockwork Mausoleum
encounters.location: Old road east of Veylathar • Buried road
encounters.hook: Bronze funeral defenses rise because an ancient culture assumed all travelers were grave robbers.
encounters.roster: 1 Tomb Marshal: AC16 HP75 +6, 2d8+4; 3 Brass Dead: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3; 2 Key-Spiders: AC13 HP10 +4, steal item
encounters.battlefield: Open burial shafts, sinking stone doors, brass bells under the road.
encounters.motivation: The machines want intruders to return stolen grave tokens that nobody actually stole.
encounters.alternateEndings: Ring the central bell three times, return a found token, or outrun the sinking road.
encounters.reward: Clockwork key: opens one nonmagical lock automatically.

encounters.name: Choir of Blinding Wings
encounters.hook: Holy guardians judge Coleman’s shapeshifting as forbidden under an ancient, outdated law.
encounters.roster: 1 Radiant Adjudicator: AC16 HP80 +6, 2d10 radiant; 2 Winged Lancers: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3; 2 Halo Wisps: AC14 HP18, DC13 blind/restraint
encounters.battlefield: Bright zones empower celestials; shade protects the party. Narrow cliffs create falling danger.
encounters.motivation: They are not evil. They are dangerously certain they are right.
encounters.alternateEndings: Invoke Aureth, show mercy, protect Coleman, or force the Adjudicator to reconsider.
encounters.reward: Dawn feather: end fear or magical darkness once.

encounters.name: Saltglass Wyrm
encounters.location: Izdari Sands glass basin • Giant beast
encounters.hook: A burrowing wyrm mistakes enchanted armor and rune weapons for mineral deposits it eats.
encounters.roster: 1 Saltglass Wyrm: AC15 HP110 +6, 2d10+4; 3 Glass Mites: AC13 HP10 +4, 1d6+2
encounters.battlefield: Crystal ridges can be shattered for 2d6 area damage. Reflections create false positions.
encounters.motivation: It is hungry, not evil, and it wants metal more than blood.
encounters.alternateEndings: Feed it metal, lure it away, protect the supply wagon until it retreats.
encounters.reward: Three reflective scales usable by a smith.

encounters.name: Iron Banner Surveyors
encounters.location: Frostgrim western border pass • Rival kingdom
encounters.hook: Foreign engineers are quietly marking land for a road, fort, or future invasion.
encounters.roster: 1 Banner Knight: AC16 HP75 +6, 2d8+4; 4 Pike Soldiers: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3; 2 Survey Adepts: AC14 HP24, DC13 smoke/trip lines
encounters.battlefield: Survey chains trip movement; black stakes mark enemy firing lanes.
encounters.motivation: They want to finish their map and leave with it.
encounters.alternateEndings: Duel, seize the map, negotiate, expose an expired treaty, or escort them away.
encounters.reward: Border map showing a safe pass and abandoned fort.

encounters.name: Blackwake Marauders
encounters.location: Icewind Port / southern coast • Pirate thieves
encounters.hook: Hidden chains drag the party’s ferry sideways toward a black-sailed raider ship.
encounters.roster: 1 Pirate Captain: AC16 HP70 +6, 2d8+4; 3 Deck Raiders: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3; 3 Rope-Runners: AC13 HP18 +4, steal item
encounters.battlefield: Two moving decks, ropes, cargo, deep water. Falling overboard costs a turn unless rescued.
encounters.motivation: They want food, medicine, weapons, and royal-looking valuables.
encounters.alternateEndings: Cut the chain, seize the winch, board their ship, bargain, or scare them off.
encounters.reward: Pirate route chart and grappling launcher.

encounters.name: Skyhook Reavers
encounters.location: Izdari Sands caravan road • Airship pirates
encounters.hook: An airship drops hooked chains and begins lifting soldiers, wagons, and heroes into the sky.
encounters.roster: 1 Hookmaster: AC16 HP80 +6, 2d10+4; 2 Chain Bruisers: AC14 HP55 +5, 2d8+3; 4 Sail Raiders: AC13 HP18 +4, 1d6+2
encounters.battlefield: Chains rise 10 feet each round. Heroes can climb, cut, swing, ride, or board.
encounters.motivation: They want the Garrison banner and royal seal as trophies.
encounters.alternateEndings: Cut anchor chains, rescue soldiers, board the ship, or have Coleman pull it down.
encounters.reward: Folded sky-sail: two people glide safely once.

encounters.name: Singing Stones
encounters.location: Dawnmoor cliffs / lower Serenth canyon • Elemental hazard
encounters.hook: A magical windstorm awakens stone creatures whose song shatters metal and pushes travelers toward danger.
encounters.roster: 1 Resonance Giant: AC16 HP90 +6, 2d10 thunder; 3 Chime Golems: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3; 2 Windlings: AC14 HP20, DC13 push
encounters.battlefield: Gust lanes push targets 10 feet. Metal items hum and may be dropped.
encounters.motivation: The stones are reacting to sound, not choosing sides.
encounters.alternateEndings: Break the harmony, topple a standing stone, match the melody, or survive the storm.
encounters.reward: Chime shard: whisper 300 feet through stone.

encounters.name: Ashmaw Pack
encounters.hook: Beasts descended from creatures stranded during an ancient opening to the Seven Hells hunt the party’s food.
encounters.roster: 1 Ashmaw Alpha: AC14 HP70 +5, 2d8+3; 4 Cinder Hounds: AC13 HP22 +4, 1d6+2 fire; 2 Ember Bats: AC13 HP12, smoke cloud
encounters.battlefield: Steam clouds, burning reeds, wet ground, food sacks under attack.
encounters.motivation: They are hungry animals, not villains.
encounters.alternateEndings: Feed them, drive off the Alpha, protect supplies, or scare them with a bigger beast.
encounters.reward: Ember gland: keeps a campfire burning seven nights.

encounters.name: Dead King’s Watch
encounters.location: Western old battlefield near Petaltown • Honorable undead
encounters.hook: The Garrison banner resembles that of an ancient enemy, awakening soldiers who still guard a lost kingdom.
encounters.roster: 1 Oathbound General: AC16 HP85 +6, 2d10+4; 4 Grave Guards: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3; 2 Banner Shades: AC14 HP18, fear DC13
encounters.battlefield: Trenches, broken shields, spectral banners. Tearing down banners weakens fear effects.
encounters.motivation: They believe the old war is still happening.
encounters.alternateEndings: Lower the banner, speak the lost kingdom’s name, duel the General, or return his sword.
encounters.reward: Oath coin: demand one minute of parley with undead soldiers once.

encounters.name: Griffin Patrol
encounters.location: Sunreach border road • Rival air cavalry
encounters.hook: A neighboring kingdom’s griffin riders mistake Fiona’s Garrison squad for an unauthorized military incursion.
encounters.roster: 1 Griffin Commander: AC16 HP70 +6, 2d8+4; 2 Griffin Riders: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3; 3 Griffins: AC14 HP40 +5, 2d6+3
encounters.battlefield: Airborne riders, dives, ledges, dropped weapons, scary but nonlethal takedowns.
encounters.motivation: They want papers, names, destination, and the banner lowered.
encounters.alternateEndings: Formal parley, Queen Flower projection, border writ, guided crossing, or aerial duel.
encounters.reward: Border writ: safe passage through one rival checkpoint.
